name: Qi Ji - Eastpoint Mall
description:
MUST TRY: Expect indulgent signatures such as Popiah, Nasi Lemak Set, Noodles, Homemade Beverages and a lot more. Qi Ji offers some of the best Halal and Singaporean cuisines using the finest ingredients. It serves a tantalising collection of dishes ranging from Nasi Lemak, Popiah, Noodles, side dishes and desserts, as well as beverages, so there is something for everyone on the menu. Located at Eastpoint Mall along Simei Street 6 (nearest train: Simei MRT Station), Qi Ji is a great place where families and friends can enjoy a delectable array of authentic Singaporean fare in a relaxed and casual atmosphere. 
Source: hungrygowhere.com
